description: Na₈Fe₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.70 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.41 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four FeO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 26°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.59 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-53°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.42 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-91°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.41 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.43 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.65 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.49 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.92 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (1.87 Å) and one longer (1.93 Å) Fe-O bond length. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Fe atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₅Fe octahedra that share corners with two ONa₅Fe octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₆Fe pentagonal bipyramid, edges with two ONa₅Fe octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₆Fe pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-66°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Fe atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₅Fe octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₅Fe octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₆Fe pentagonal bipyramid, edges with four ONa₅Fe octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₆Fe pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to six Na and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₆Fe pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with three ONa₅Fe octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₆Fe pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with five ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-33°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₅Fe octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₅Fe octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₆Fe pentagonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent ONa₅Fe octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₆Fe pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 7°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Fe atom.
